title: Favourite drummers and old-timers
summary: Howard names drummers he admired, including Roy Evans, Alfred Williams and Albert Martin, and says he heard Baby Dodds only later.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Oh, now one more question sort of puts you on the spot about who your favorite drummers are, or who they were at all times, not just today. Who was about the best drummer you ever heard? Oh, no.
You got me there.
You got me there. Who did I do? You got me there. I couldn't.
Well, I had some, I had some, I had some, I had played with some, now a fellow like Troy Weiss died, Roy Evans, he was a wonderful drummer.
You see?
Alfred William is a good drummer. Yeah? Yeah.
Well, there's been a lot of good drummer.
No, but George, not George, I mean, Albert Martin, he's a wonderful drummer. I see.
Was it Henry Martin, was he always? Yeah. I used to hear it.
Oh, Henry Martin, yeah, but I mean, at my time when I was coming, I know Henry Martin and Martin and all them fellas, but they wasn't sitting in at that time with Mr. Perry.
Do you remember Red Happy, who used to be a drummer and all that?
Yeah, yeah, at Larry Theater, yeah. Wonderful. He was one of them. Yeah. Zuri, I remember Zuri, but he was at Larry.
Remember him hearing Baby Dodds down here?
No, I never heard Baby down here. I heard him down here after George went to New York with George. Yeah, but I didn't know him before that time.
Remember any other real old timers like Louis Cantrell or Cantrell? Yeah, Louis Cantrell, yeah.
You remember him?
Yeah, I remember him.
Yeah, he's a good drummer, musical drummer.
Remember Mac Murray here?
Mac Murray, oh. Before your time.

Walter Grundy, every year, didn't he? But Walter? He played with the bunk way back, then he took out the taranet. I didn't see it before your time. No, no, I didn't know him. Well, we're just about out of the tape here. Unless there's something else that you want to add?
Well, there ain't nothing else I could say. We're all of the day.
